title: Synthetic unavailable spindle with zero drive current
provenance_detail: Original synthetic troubleshooting guidance for the ShopfloorPilot demonstration; it is not equipment-specific and is based only on named observable fields.

chunks.evidence_excerpt: When a synthetic machine is unavailable and spindle drive current reads zero mA, verify the visible supply indication, enable chain, safety interlock state, drive indication, and current-sensor path. A zero reading alone cannot distinguish an electrical, control, safety, or measurement condition.
observable_symptoms: spindle drive current reads zero mA
chunks.possible_explanation: An absent supply, disabled enable chain, open interlock, drive-indication issue, or current-measurement issue is possible.
suggested_checks: Have an authorized operator verify visible supply and enable indications without bypassing safeguards.
Record the safety interlock and drive status indications available to the simulator.
Repeat or cross-check the current reading before interpreting it.
limitations: The current value is a synthetic observation, not a calibrated electrical measurement.
The note cannot select among the listed possibilities or authorize restoration.
